title: Lost Vape Thelema Mini Vape Kit
description: The Lost Vape Thelema Mini 45W vape kit is a super-compact and lightweight, pocket-friendly starter kit that offers vapers a wide range of vaping experiences from one simple-to-use device. Built from durable zinc alloy and stainless steel, the classic box mod looks of the Thelema Mini are wrapped in stylish panels of patterned faux leather panels that offer a comfortable, tactile grip in a range of eye-catching designs. Powered by a long-lasting 1500mAh internal battery capable of firing up to 45W, the Thelema Mini features fast USB-C charging . Read and adjust settings from a simple, clear 0.69” display and easily adjust the variable wattage for ultimate control over the intensity of your vape. The Lost Vape Thelema Mini 45W vape kit includes the UB Lite Tank, a versatile sub-ohm tank designed for use with Lost Vape’s improved UB Lite mesh coils, available in a range of resistances. The kit includes 1 x UB Lite L7 0.3 Ohm Mesh Coil for a rich and cloudy DTL (direct-to-lung) vape, and 1 x UB Lite L10 0.6 Ohm Mesh Coil for a RDTL (restricted direct-to-lung) / MTL (mouth-to-lung) hybrid-style vape. Browse our e-liquid selection and find the perfect flavour to match your vape kit. Recommended Coil Pairings: Lost Vape UB 0.3Ω DTL (pre-installed): Use exclusively with High VG (Sub-Ohm) e-liquids. Lost Vape 1.2Ω MTL: Best paired with 50/50 (Freebase) or Nic Salt e-liquids. The UB Lite Tank features an innovative sliding top cap that reveals an upgraded fill port for easy, leak-free refills, and switching coils is made easy with an intuitive push-to-fit design. We recommend nic salt and high-PG e-liquids for use with the 0.6ohm UB Lite coil, and 50/50 and high-VG e-liquids for use with the 0.3ohm UB Lite coil. With its 510 connection, the Thelema Mini 45W Box Mod can be used with any compatible 510 tank, as can the Lost Vape UB Lite Tank be used with any compatible 510 Box Mod. Please Note: To improve the performance and longevity of your new Coils, always prime them with your chosen e-liquid before inserting into your device 'Priming' simply means wetting the exposed cotton or similar wicking material with e-liquid before use. This helps prevent dry hits and burning the coil should it fail to soak up e-liquid properly before firing the vape device. Once you've primed your pod, attached it to your device, allow to stand for 5-10 minutes before vaping.
